tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H=0.16–0.48, far shorter than the target horizon, and the proposed five-parameter mechanism has an unidentified slow component. The slow-horizon probe directly tests long-horizon adaptation and supplies the needed information.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation timescale or reliably extrapolate to H=22.3.
A finer short trajectory is less directly informative about the long-horizon reversal and slow timescale.
The auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to the stated identifiability ambiguity.
The pilot does not establish periodic behavior, while the slow-horizon probe can discriminate the cited adaptation mechanism.
